text.content:
President of the NUSA.

Role: President, New United States of America
Affiliation: Formerly CEO of Militech
Known for: The Unification War

Former CEO of Militech, elected the NUSA's third president in 2065. Her plan to bring the Free States back under federal rule became the Unification War in 2069. That autumn she seized Danger Gal's East Coast offices and opened Michiko Arasaka's sealed file. In June 2070 her army stopped at Night City's gates when Arasaka's supercarrier arrived.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.6; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05
